title: XML Element
description: JSON Schema describing the structure of an XML element including its qualified name, attributes, child nodes, and text content.

namespaceURI.description: Namespace URI in scope for this element.

prefix.description: Namespace prefix used for this element (empty string for default namespace).

qualifiedName.description: Qualified name combining prefix and local name (e.g. xs:element).

children.description: Child nodes (elements, text, CDATA, comments, processing instructions).

value.description: Node content. For element nodes, an XML Element object; for text/cdata/comment, a string; for processing instructions, an object with target and data.

text.description: Concatenated text content of the element (per XPath string-value).

selfClosing.description:
Whether the element is serialized using the self-closing form (e.g.
).

xmlLang.description: xml:lang value declaring the language of the element content.

xmlBase.description: xml:base value providing a base URI for relative references.

xmlId.description: xml:id value uniquely identifying the element within the document.
